l40s_generation_vs_a100.basis: NOT MEASURED. Decoding long reasoning traces at high concurrency reads each sequence's KV cache every step, so it is memory-bandwidth bound: the L40S's 864 GB/s is 0.42 of the A100 SXM4's 2,039 GB/s, and at gpu_memory_utilization 0.90 the L40S holds about half the A100's KV cache (about 30 GiB after the 8 GB of weights, against about 63), which bounds concurrency; prefill is compute-bound, where the two cards are comparable. Replaced by the L40S check's measured tokens per second on the teacher session's own runner

l40s_step_vs_a100.basis: the one measured same-recipe pair (E1's recipe, cross-context): 3.6314 s on the L40S against 3.33 s on the A100; conservative 1.25 because document isolation runs a masked attention kernel the pair did not exercise. Replaced by the check's measured formal step

l40s_operators_vs_a100.basis: the same training-step ratio; no L40S timing of the D4 path on these items exists
